subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should `sessions.create` permanently expose the optional tri-state `succeedsParent` contract, with omission preserving the shipped rollover behavior?
rationale: This is a public gateway lifecycle API affecting out-of-tree callers and session-generation ownership; source review can validate the implementation but cannot choose the permanent protocol contract.

options.title: Accept additive tri-state contract
options.body: Keep the optional boolean, preserve legacy rollover when omitted, use explicit false for parallel children, and rebase its TUI wiring onto current main.

options.title: Use an explicit disposition enum
options.body: Replace the boolean with a clearer successor-versus-parallel protocol value while retaining a backward-compatible omitted behavior.

options.title: Keep the distinction internal
options.body: Avoid a new public parameter and classify only known in-repository creation paths at a narrower owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept additive tri-state contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional boolean, preserve legacy rollover when omitted, use explicit false for parallel children, and rebase its TUI wiring onto current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Control UI `/new` lifecycle implementation is the closest provenance for the public parent-rollover contract.
